hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $d = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); $p = Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR ('devlog\' + $d + '.md'); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { Write-Output ('提醒：今天还没有写开发日志 devlog/' + $d + '.md，请按 CLAUDE.md 规则更新后再结束会话。') }"
